title: Using a Cognitive Architecture to consider antiblackness in design and development of AI systems
benchmark_measurement: The paper did not measure anything in terms of faith or religion. Its focus was on using a cognitive architecture to consider antiblackness and racism in the design and development of AI systems.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as its focus is on antiblackness, racism, and sociocultural hierarchies in the context of AI development and cognitive modeling.
